notes.title: ARK BOX Unlimited Update 1.1.0 has been released!
notes.notes:
Update 1.1.0 Changelog

- Optimized coop mode
- Improved Gamepad navigation
- Reduced T2 Metal Structure HP
- Improved auto-resolution and aspect ratio handling
- Time / Score adjustments for lower speed settings
- Stage re-designs and optimized difficulty balancing
- Improved Editor navigation and collisions
- Improved Catch mechanics and Ball collisions
- Community Stages Total Score display
- Improved game performance
- Missile hit does not change block type
- Autosave for window, block and ball options
- Improved info text and power up descriptions
- Optimized fullscreen and windowed mode init

We hope you enjoy! Feedback is very welcome.
